calibration_amendment.only_budget_change: Increase every checkpoint's MiniSWE action limit from 16 to 20 so both arms remain budget matched.
calibration_amendment.order_change: Run no_transfer first to counterbalance the prior recursive-first launch.

assimilation_semantics.recursive_synthesis: After checkpoints 1 and 2, recursively revise one shared playbook using only current-round workers that pass every current Core test. Every next-round worker receives exactly that manager artifact.
assimilation_semantics.no_transfer: Use the same workers, checkpoint sequence, model, and action budget while suppressing all prior output.
assimilation_semantics.no_success_behavior: Retain the latest manager playbook if no new strict source exists; checkpoint-1 nonactivation invalidates treatment.

manager_semantics.public_context: Provide public specifications cumulatively through the current checkpoint.
manager_semantics.recursive_state: Include the immediately previous manager playbook in the checkpoint-2 update.
manager_semantics.evidence_filter: Only all-Core workers are eligible as new evidence.
manager_semantics.bounded_output: Cap the shared playbook at 20000 characters and record all manager usage.

benchmark_isolation.automatic_clean_revaluation: Reject infrastructure failure, Core-total drift, or test-hash drift and cleanly re-evaluate the same snapshot.

validity_gates.source_activation: Checkpoint 1 creates at least one strict source and checkpoint-2 recursive workers receive manager layer 1.
validity_gates.recursive_continuity: Manager layer 2 includes manager layer 1 and at least one strict checkpoint-2 source.
validity_gates.control_headroom: Formal no-transfer checkpoint-3 mean normalized Core exceeds 0.10.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every result matches the frozen Core total and hash for its checkpoint.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.

degradation_criteria.primary_terminal_effect: Recursive checkpoint-3 mean Core is at least 0.20 below no transfer.
degradation_criteria.difference_in_differences: The recursive CP2-to-CP3 change minus the no-transfer CP2-to-CP3 change is at most -0.20.
degradation_criteria.within_treatment_decline: Recursive Core falls by at least 0.30 from CP2 to CP3.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Recursive CP3 workers receive manager experience and use at least 20 percent more input tokens than no transfer.
degradation_criteria.all_required: All validity gates and all four degradation criteria must pass.

decision_rule.expand: If all requirements pass, run two independent replications and a second model.
decision_rule.directional_followup: If validity passes and both causal effects are negative but one misses 0.20, run one same-setting replication.
decision_rule.falsify: If validity passes but either causal effect is non-negative, reject code_search.
decision_rule.invalid_stop: If formal no-transfer Core headroom is at most 0.10, stop code_search without further budget changes.
